issue.description: Build a reusable static PGN analysis app with local Stockfish evaluation, replay, move quality labels, and browser verification. Publish it to chess.jedarden.com through Forgejo, Argo/Cloudflare Pages, and required DNS/custom-domain setup. Keep site copy independent of other chess services. Record verification and deployment references.
issue.notes: Implemented static Vite app with local Stockfish 19 small network WASM, PGN parsing, animated board replay, position score graph, move labels, summary, and Agentation. Unit tests: npm test (5 pass). Build: npm run build (pass). Headless Chromium on Vite dev: 68/68 sample positions analyzed, final +M1, Agentation mounted. Publication still pending.
issue.title: Build and publish browser chess analysis at chess.jedarden.com
